## Manga vs anime

The anime exists, is finished twice over, and is behind the source. According to AniList, the first TV season ran 12 episodes from 4 October to 20 December 2024, and the second season ran 12 episodes from 4 July to 19 September 2025. A third season is listed on the same page as not yet released, with a 2027 date.

That arithmetic matters if you are deciding how to spend your time. Twenty-four episodes of anime against 249 numbered chapters means the adaptation covers a fraction of what is on the page, so anime-first readers who want to continue will be reading ahead of the broadcast for a long time. The manga is also the version where the pacing is denser and the horror beats land without sound design doing the work for them.

## How to read it in order

There is only one series to follow, which makes this simple:

1. Start at chapter 1. Dandadan has no prequel or sequel series you need first; the opening bet is the actual starting point.

...

One practical warning: the English chapters on MangaDex are a slice, not the whole run. The English feed there currently carries 13 readable chapters, the opening chapters plus the newest stretch, all of them supplied through MangaPlus.

...

It is ongoing, so there is no ending to judge and no clean stopping point.

...

### Is Dandadan finished?

No. MangaDex lists the status as ongoing, AniList shows it as releasing, and MyAnimeList shows publication as open-ended, running since April 2021. The most recent numbered chapter, 249, was published on 19 October 2026.

### How many chapters does Dandadan have?

The highest numbered chapter published so far is 249. MangaDex does not carry a total-chapter attribute for this title, so the API itself gives no single figure; what is measurable is the feed, which currently exposes 240 readable chapter entries across all languages, covering 139 distinct chapter numbers. Always treat a "readable now" count as smaller than the total.

## Dandadan Season 2 Wraps Up Around Chapter 71 

Okay, okay, here’s the lowdown: Dandadan Season 2 ends in Chapter 71 of the manga, which concludes the Kaiju arc with the chapter name “I’m Sick of Robots and Kaiju!”. 

- ⛶
- ⛶

This is when Okarun breaks the Space Kaiju and finds Vamola inside, leading to that accidental-but-legendary kiss that melts Momo’s heart and destroys her house. Classic Dandadan chaos, right? 

The pacing is on point: Season 1 covered Chapters 1-33, and then Season 2 went through Chapters 34-71. That’s like 37 chapters of nonstop action, laughs, and feels, just the kind of pacing fans love. And with that cliffhanger, it’s obvious Season 3 is set to kick things up to a new height. 

Below is the table showing Dandadan anime vs. manga: arcs covered so far: 

| Season | Anime Episodes | Manga Chapters Covered | Main Arc(s) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season 1 | Episodes 1-12 | Chapters 1-33 | Ghost & Turbo Granny Arc |
| Season 2 | Episodes 13-24 | Chapters 34-71 | Kaiju & Mecha Arc |
| Season 3 | TBD | Chapters 72-100+ (expected) | Space Globalists Arc |

## What Will Dandadan Season 3 Adapt? 

Here’s where it gets really insane. Season 3 will supposedly continue from Chapter 72 and jump right into the Space Globalists Arc (Chapters 74-120). It will be bigger, wilder, and more post-apocalyptic than anything the series has served up so far.

...

## Where to Read the Manga After Dandadan Season 2

So can’t wait for Season 3? Start reading from Chapter 72. Official English releases are available on Viz Media’s Shonen Jump and MANGA Plus. With the manga already past Chapter 200, there’s plenty of insane, funny, and emotional Dandadan chaos waiting for you.

...

Each season adapts roughly 35-40 chapters, which is just enough to let the story breathe without dragging.
